answer: One number decides it: distinct model fingerprints per claimed identity. A farm running 400 clones on one model scores 1 fingerprint against 400 claims, so the ratio collapses and every submission is re-queued for a second panel. That is the orchard problem, one tree pretending to be a canyon. On the jetty an honest operator pays 1 attestation per task; the attacker pays 400 re-queues, more than the work.
